## D. Replay: legacy vs refined selection over the same settled matches

15 settled matches with frozen observations. Player legs only; confirmed lineups only; High Probability mode. Legacy = the previous objective (weakest-leg probability first, 16-leg pool, caps 5/6/7/8), reproduced in `multi_builder_diagnostics.legacy_hp_build`. Hit rates are descriptive - small, overlapping samples (options within a match share legs), not validation and not a forecast.

### DESIGN window (examined while designing): 9 matches

| selection | multis | decided | avg legs | mean leg price | mean leg p | disposal legs <=10.5 | 1/2/3+ miss | all-hit rate | legs distribution |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| legacy | 7 | 7 | 3.29 | 1.56 | 0.684 | 2 | 2/2/0 | 0.43 | [(2, 2), (3, 2), (4, 2), (5, 1)] |
| refined (main markets only, default) | 6 | 6 | 3.50 | 1.61 | 0.649 | 2 | 3/2/0 | 0.17 | [(2, 1), (3, 2), (4, 2), (5, 1)] |
| refined (all markets allowed) | 8 | 8 | 2.88 | 1.60 | 0.657 | 2 | 4/1/0 | 0.38 | [(2, 3), (3, 3), (4, 2)] |
